title: Riot Squad Punx Guava, Passion Fruit and Pineapple  50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Experience a tropical paradise with every puff when you try the Riot Squad Punx Guava Passion Fruit and Pineapple 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid. This unique blend combines the sweet, juicy taste of guava with the tangy, bittersweet flavour of passion fruit. Paired with a splash of the bright, tropical taste of pineapple. The result is a deliciously exotic Guava Passion Fruit and Pineapple vape juice that’s perfect for anyone looking for a taste of the Caribbean. Order the Punk Guava Passion Fruit and Pineapple by Riot Squad today to treat your taste buds to a tropical holiday with every puff! This delicious Riot Squad Punx Guava, Passion Fruit and Pineapple 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid flavour is also available as a Riot Squad Nic Salt. Which is perfect for vapers looking to soothe their nicotine cravings with a super smooth throat hit from the Riot Squad Punx E-Liquid range. Don’t miss out, check out the equally delicious Riot Squad Punx Guava, Passion Fruit & Pineapple Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml . Or try the Riot Squad BAR EDTN Guava Passionfruit & Pineapple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid 20mg today ! This convenient Riot Squad 50ml nicotine-free Shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a Nicotine Shot to tailor your vape to your liking. For example, adding an 18mg Nic Shot will turn your 50ml Riot Squad Shortfills into 50ml of 3mg E Liquid. What’s more, this Riot Squad Shortfill features a 70VG/30PG ratio. Making it ideal for Sub-Ohm Vape Kits. As it’s the perfect E Liquid ratio for large cloud creation that doesn’t lessen your vape juice flavour. Allowing you to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours to the max. Using naturally derived vegetable glycerine and propylene glycol with pharmaceutical-grade nicotine. Riot Squad’s Vape Juices are renowned for their supreme quality and ability to deliver huge flavoursome vapour clouds. So if you are looking for delicious flavour and high-quality E-Liquids for your vapes, you can be confident the Riot Squad UK-based E-Liquid manufacturer will deliver premium, flavourful vapour clouds and explosively delicious flavours in every puff! If you love this delicious Riot Squad Shortfill 50ml, then check out their other equally moreish 10ml & 50ml E-Liquids. Designed to suit any vapers flavour requirements, you’re bound to find a Riot Squad Vape juice you’ll love. Go ahead treat your taste buds to an explosion of juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverages, Confectionary/desserts, classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours from Riot Squad's delicious Black Edition, Menthol, BAR EDTN and Punx E-Liquid ranges. Love the flavour of Riot Squad Shortfills, but don’t want the hassle of refilling or maintaining your vape device? Check out the Riot Squad Disposable Vapes . These super convenient Disposable Vapes are a great way to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours on the go.
